de94e57cdb78a518.text: Thursday morning, by the coffee machine.

f5fe2aae55a2ea0e.text: My assistant has to explain why a parcel is late. That starts with the weather in the depot's city.

eb6c5348c94a5e1e.text: Search wrote a weather lookup, Billing a calculator. I do not want a fifth way.

dfa39b81a2569f84.text: Security wants one door. Agents ask a server what tools it has, then call them by name. See it from the agent's side.

84511f6dfc9af458.text: A tool gateway, with a weather server and a calculator behind it.

33be4fb371875baa.text: Look at the request bodies, and at what comes back when a call goes right and when it does not.

84b86eda1b047fef.text: My assistant will read those answers. The shape of a failure matters to me.
